en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a circular, multi‑story pavilion or exhibition building with a tall, tapering tower at the top. The structure is ringed with balconies, railings, and decorative elements, and flags fly from poles around it. Crowds of people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk on a wet plaza in front of the building. Smaller exhibition halls and booths surround the central pavilion. The overall scene suggests a fairground or international exposition.
